skills.name: Preparing a respectful discussion of sexual health

note.text: A responsible classroom discussion uses accurate terms, respect and age-appropriate information. Consent, privacy, reliable sources and seeking appropriate help are useful discussion themes. Health status does not determine a person's worth. The exercise uses fictional situations and requires no personal disclosures. This is written preparation for a language discussion, not a diagnosis or a substitute for advice from trained health professionals.

sections.heading: Apply the ideas locally
sections.text: Original dialogue: Bih asks how to check a health message shared online. Ayuk suggests comparing it with an established health source and asking a trained professional when unsure. Another speaker adds that nobody should be pressured to describe private experiences. They agree to discuss claims respectfully and avoid spreading rumours about classmates.

sections.heading: Reason and check
sections.text: Separate a question about information from a request for private details. Give a reason when judging a source: popularity alone does not establish accuracy. Use neutral wording and encourage appropriate support rather than shame. Teachers should review discussion suitability for the class before oral practice.
